transcript: There's this really cute Spanish theater right above Gramercy called Repertorio Español, and Paul and I recently went there to see a comedy called La Ternura. It's about these three women who excitedly wash up on a desert island where they plan to live peacefully without the presence of men. Little do they know, three men already inhabit this island and are delighted to be without the presence of women. What ensues is a series of disguises, mistaken identities, and unexpected connections. It's somewhat Shakespearean in its ridiculousness, but I thought it was charming, even with all its clichés. Like all the shows at Repertorio Español, this is performed in Spanish, but if you're like me and not a Spanish speaker, they'll set you up with a translation device so you can still get a good grasp of what's going on. With that, another program for my collection.
